gloss: to lead to; to be understood; to be versed in (formal {通|つう}じる)

definitions.gloss: to lead to; to be understood; to be versed in (formal {通|つう}じる)
definitions.explanation: A formal, written form of {通|つう}じる with the same meanings: of a road or door, to lead somewhere; of words or feelings, to get across; of a person, to know a field well.

examples.english: This road leads to the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{相通|あいつう}ずるもの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The two of them think alike in some ways.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{通|つう}ずる⟦{普遍的|ふへんてき}→普遍的：13026_fuhenteki⟧な⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: His works have universal themes that speak even to young people today.

notes:
FORMS:
{通|つう}ずる is the older ずる-verb form of ⟦{通|つう}じる→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧. Most of its forms are now the ⟦{通|つう}じる→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧ ones ({通|つう}じない, {通|つう}じた, {通|つう}じて); {通|つう}ずる itself survives mainly in the dictionary form, before nouns, and in set phrases.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {相通|あいつう}ずる: to have something in common
- すべて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ローマ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|つう}ず→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧: all roads lead to Rome (classical form ず)
- ⟦{意|い}→意：30489_i⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|つう}ずる: to make one's meaning understood

REGISTER:
Formal and written; in conversation, ⟦{通|つう}じる→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧ is the normal form.
